purpose: Machine-readable coverage ledger for AI-audio detection, provenance/watermark robustness, forensic analysis, controlled adversarial robustness evaluation, vocoder artifact benchmarking, restoration and cleanup references.

entries.name: geeknik/mmm
entries.notes: Use only as a controlled robustness transform source. Preserve perceptual/content impact and follow with defense/provenance retest.

entries.name: Angel2mp3/AudioAuditor
entries.notes: Validate fake-lossless, cutoff and AI-audio heuristics separately; do not treat unverified 2D-FFT/Suno-specific claims as ground truth.

entries.name: gemelo-ai/vocos
entries.notes: Matched resynthesis benchmark against other vocoder families; measure spectral periodicity, HF behavior, phase/coherence and transients.

entries.name: NVIDIA/BigVGAN
entries.notes: Matched comparison with Vocos; alias-free design is a hypothesis source, not proof of artifact absence.

entries.name: piotrkawa/audio-deepfake-adversarial-attacks
entries.notes: Primary attack-defense benchmark source. Track clean vs challenged accuracy, confidence drift, FPR/FNR movement, audibility and defensive retest.

entries.name: piotrkawa/attack-agnostic-dataset
entries.notes: Use as supporting reproducibility/reference pipeline for adversarial detector evaluation.

entries.name: RawNet3 / Jungjee/RawNet family
entries.notes: Track separately from the containing adversarial-evaluation repository because detector-family behavior is an independent result.

entries.name: clovaai/aasist
entries.notes: Independent detector-family benchmark; preserve exact checkpoint/config and dataset identity.

entries.name: LCNN detector configuration
entries.notes: Separate result row despite being exposed through the same repository.

entries.name: SpecRNet detector configuration
entries.notes: Separate result row despite being exposed through the same repository.

entries.name: facebookresearch/audioseal
entries.notes: Positive-control watermark system for localization, codec/edit robustness and calibration.

entries.name: haoheliu/versatile_audio_super_resolution
entries.notes: Judge with loudness-matched A/B, content-retention and delta-oriented QC; generated HF detail is not assumed faithful.

entries.name: henricksmedia/shimmer
entries.notes: Cross-reference docs/SHIMMER_EXTERNAL_REFERENCE.md. Test cleanup-before-mastering, Removed/Delta audition, loudness-matched A/B, HF Mid/Side cleanup and transient safety.

entries.name: oeksound Spiff
entries.blocker: Requires an authorized locally installed instance plus exact version/state/render-mode capture, pairwise alignment/gain admissibility and replay-equivalence validation.
entries.notes: Reference-only adaptive transient processor. Measure realized attack/sustain deltas from aligned outputs/residuals; do not assume sustain/body is unchanged.

entries.name: oeksound soothe3
entries.blocker: Requires an authorized locally installed instance plus exact version/state/render-mode capture, pairwise alignment/gain admissibility and replay-equivalence validation.
entries.notes: Reference-only dynamic resonance suppression candidate for harshness/damage-guard calibration. A marker improvement alone is not a production success criterion.

entries.name: oeksound Bloom
entries.blocker: Requires an authorized locally installed instance plus exact version/state/render-mode capture, pairwise alignment/gain admissibility and replay-equivalence validation.
entries.notes: Reference-only adaptive tone-shaping candidate for ordinary-processing robustness. Detector-score reduction is explicitly not an optimization objective.

entries.name: authio / Forward Digital AI Music Checker
entries.blocker: Requires current terms/privacy review and an audio fixture explicitly authorized for third-party disclosure.
entries.notes: Record service/model revision or UNKNOWN and preserve returned score semantics.

entries.name: ACRCloud AI Music Detector
entries.blocker: Requires access plus current terms/privacy review and an authorized disclosure fixture.
entries.notes: Do not treat vendor output as ground truth.

entries.name: IRCAM Amplify AIMD
entries.blocker: Requires service access plus current terms/privacy review and an authorized disclosure fixture.
entries.notes: Preserve product/revision identity when exposed.

entries.name: Pex / Vobile AI Song Detector
entries.blocker: Requires enterprise/demo/API access plus current terms/privacy review and an authorized disclosure fixture.
entries.notes: External disagreement is benchmark evidence, not majority-vote truth.

entries.name: Detector24 AI Music Detection
entries.blocker: Requires current access/terms/privacy review and an authorized disclosure fixture.
entries.notes: Preserve exact access date and returned verdict semantics.

entries.name: PesneGen online track analysis
entries.blocker: Requires current terms/privacy review and an authorized disclosure fixture.
entries.notes: Accessible external comparison candidate; raw/structured output should be retained only when terms permit.
